caseTitle: Knitting chart: coffee bean cup cosy
prompt: Make an SVG knitting chart for a cup cosy with a coffee-bean motif, drawn so the beans come out the right shape in the finished fabric.

<title>Bean • a gauge-correct knitting chart for a cup cosy</title>

<text x="72" y="872" class="small" >Swatch in stranded stockinette.</text>

<text x="72" y="950" class="small" >This compensates for stitch shape</text>

<text x="400" y="950" class="small" >In A: 4 rounds of k1, p1 rib.</text>
